name: MoneyDream
summary:
"Money Dream" VR – The Most Ridiculous "Cash Rain" Simulator!
 
Super Simple, Insanely Fun!
Sit on a virtual bed, grab pizza, hot dogs, gold coins, dollar bills, or diamonds from the bedside, and hurl them at the ceiling—instantly, the room gets flooded with an epic downpour of food or money!

🍕 Pizza Storm: Hot, cheesy slices rain down on you—smells unreal!
💰 Gold Coin Tsunami: Shiny coins pour endlessly—grab handfuls like a pirate!
